hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: With words length up to 10^5, quadratic pairwise comparison is too slow.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: A word s1 is both a prefix and suffix of s2 if character pairs (s2[k], s2[len - 1 - k]) match s1 simultaneously.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Insert words into a Trie where each transition branch is keyed on the character pair (s[k], s[len - 1 - k]). Accumulate counts of visited word endpoints.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: sum(len(w)): total length of all words
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2 * L) quadratic string comparisons time out for n = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(total characters) memory for Trie nodes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that prefix-suffix equality can be tracked simultaneously as character pairs in a single Trie.
